decks.title: Ch 1 — Introduction & Basic Concepts
decks.description: Systems, properties, units, temperature and pressure.

decks.title: Ch 2 — Energy, Energy Transfer & General Energy Analysis
decks.description: Forms of energy, heat, work, and the first law.

decks.title: Ch 3 — Properties of Pure Substances
decks.description: Phases, phase change, property tables, ideal gas and compressibility.

decks.title: Ch 4 — Energy Analysis of Closed Systems
decks.description: Boundary work, the closed-system first law, and specific heats.

decks.title: Ch 5 — Mass & Energy Analysis of Control Volumes
decks.description: Mass conservation, flow work, the steady-flow energy equation, and devices.

decks.title: Ch 6 — The Second Law of Thermodynamics
decks.description: Heat engines, refrigerators, reversibility, and the Carnot cycle.

decks.title: Ch 7 — Entropy
decks.description: Entropy, the increase principle, T ds relations, and isentropic processes.

decks.title: Ch 8 — Exergy
decks.description: Exergy, dead state, exergy of heat, exergy destruction, second-law efficiency.

decks.title: Power Markets & Market Design
decks.description: Merit order, marginal pricing, the day-ahead/intraday/balancing timeline, spreads, PPAs and negative prices.

decks.title: Renewable Deployment
decks.description: LCOE, capacity factors, curtailment, cannibalization, auctions/CfDs, and the grid/permit bottlenecks of deploying wind and solar.

decks.title: Energy Technologies
decks.description: Generation roles, storage (batteries, pumped hydro, hydrogen), duration vs power, round-trip efficiency, and demand-side flexibility.

decks.title: Grids & Grid-and-Compute
decks.description: TSO/DSO roles, frequency & inertia, congestion/redispatch, zonal vs nodal pricing, and siting flexible data-centre load on the grid.
